script: An unfamiliar human approached the house carrying a suspicious box. I did what any responsible dog would do, I announced the threat immediately, at maximum volume, from the safest possible distance behind the couch. And it worked. They left the box and walked away. You keep saying that's just what delivery drivers do. I say correlation is not something I'm equipped to consider right now, I barked, they left, my job here is done, and I will be taking full credit for the safety of this household today. This instinct isn't random either, it's a real territorial response, and there's a legitimate way to help a dog feel less on edge about it. The link's below.
